props.name: versions
props.description: Every version, in any order. The newest is treated as the current one.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected version id (controlled). Selecting is previewing.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected version id when uncontrolled. Defaults to the current version.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a version is selected — load its preview here.

props.name: compare
props.description: Whether the preview shows changes against the current version (controlled).

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Restore a version. Return a promise to hold the confirmation open until it settles.

props.name: defaultNamedOnly
props.description: Start with only named versions shown.

props.name: now
props.description: Today, for the Today and Yesterday headings.
